_doc: Expected Railway service-instance settings (N4.1, D-N24). They replace the config-as-code files (root railway.toml for web, deploy/railway/railway.scanner-nightly.json for scanner-nightly), which Railway stops reading on 2026-12-01. deploy_web.sh and deploy_scanner_nightly.sh read the live settings with one read-only `railway api` query (deploy/railway/service_settings.py) and refuse to deploy on any difference. Keys under serviceInstance are ServiceInstance field names; null means the setting must be unset. limits is compared with the serviceInstanceLimits query. The old files' build.builder = DOCKERFILE is carried by dockerfilePath: the instance builder field reads RAILPACK on services that built from a Dockerfile (P0A.3, docs/SCANNING_OPS_LOG.md), and on 2026-09-28 setting dockerfilePath through the API is what made scanner-nightly build its Dockerfile (docs/RAILWAY_SCANNING.md). Change a value only together with the owner settings pack that applies it (docs/RELEASING.md, Service settings). web-cards (docs/RELEASING.md, web-cards) is the nightly listings-card builder: its serviceId is not stored here (no Railway id in the repository); the deploy script and the check read it from the environment variable named by serviceIdEnv. deploy/railway/railway.web-cards.json holds the same values as a reference copy; Railway stops reading config files on 2026-12-01, so the settings below are what the guard compares.
